title: How garbage collection (mark and sweep) works
sub: Start from the things your program can reach, mark everything they touch, then sweep away whatever was never marked. Each step is one object.

title: Git merge vs rebase
sub: Same starting point, two ways to bring main's work into your branch. Watch what happens to the history, the commit hashes, and the conflicts.

title: How a hash table grows
sub: Keys land in buckets by hash. When the table gets crowded it doubles and re-hashes everything, which is what keeps lookups fast.

title: How a Raft leader election works
sub: Every node starts as a follower with a random timer. The first timer to expire asks for votes; whoever collects a majority becomes leader and keeps everyone calm with heartbeats.

title: How TCP congestion control works
sub: A sender can't see the network, so it probes: double fast, then creep up, and halve the moment packets get dropped. Each step here is one round trip.

title: How an HTTPS (TLS) handshake works
sub: Two strangers agree on a secret key in public, the server proves who it is with a certificate, and then everything is encrypted. Tiny numbers here, same idea as the real thing.
